name: Mika AI Chat
author: hiremika

sections.description:
Mika is a lead conversion platform built for small businesses. It lives on your website around the clock, answers visitor questions using your actual business information, captures leads, and books appointments. No coding, no training, no ongoing work.

Unlike generic chatbots that need scripts and decision trees, Mika reads your website and learns your business automatically. It holds natural conversations, guides visitors toward action, and sends you their contact info the moment they are ready to connect.

Why Small Businesses Choose Mika

  • Free forever plan with ~30 conversations per month
  • Works in 8 languages with automatic detection (English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Chinese, Korean)
  • Set up in under 5 minutes. Install the plugin, paste your API key, done
  • No scripts or decision trees. Mika reads your website and answers naturally
  • Captures leads automatically. Name, email, phone, and a summary of what the visitor needs
  • Books appointments directly in chat. Visitors pick a date and time without leaving your site
  • Zero-storage privacy mode for privacy-sensitive industries. No visitor data stored, PII redacted before AI processing, secure PIN-protected notifications
  • Proactive visitor engagement. Exit intent detection, scroll triggers, and returning visitor greetings to start conversations before visitors leave
  • Follow-up email sequences. Automated thank-you, reminder, review request, and rebook emails after appointments
  • Structured knowledge base. Add FAQ pairs that Mika uses to answer questions precisely, with automatic gap detection for questions it could not answer
  • Team management. Invite staff with role-based access (owner, admin, staff) and per-staff booking availability
  • Compliance disclaimer support. Built-in consent gate for law firms, medical offices, and financial advisors
  • Works on any WordPress theme. Compatible with Elementor, Divi, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, and all major page builders

Works With Your Favorite Plugins

Mika runs alongside the plugins you already use:

  • WooCommerce – Product search in chat, browsable product cards with photos
  • MemberPress – Convert visitors into paying members
  • LearnDash – Help prospective students find the right course
  • BuddyBoss – Answer community questions and drive signups
  • Gravity Forms / WPForms – Replace static forms with live conversations
  • Bookly / Amelia – Mika captures appointment requests alongside your existing booking plugin
  • Elementor / Divi / Beaver Builder – Floating widget works on any page builder

Zero-Storage Privacy Mode

For businesses in privacy-sensitive industries where visitor data needs strict handling:

  • No visitor data stored. Chat messages, leads, and appointments are never written to a database
  • PII redacted before AI processing. Phone numbers, emails, SSNs, insurance IDs, and names are replaced with tokens before reaching the AI model
  • Secure notifications. Lead details are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) into a time-limited link. PIN sent via separate SMS channel. Staff need both to view details.
  • Industry-specific guardrails. Configurable rules to keep conversations focused on scheduling and general inquiries, not sensitive topics.
  • Available on the Pro plan ($49.99/mo)

Built for healthcare practices, therapy and counseling, legal consultations, financial advisors, insurance agencies, addiction recovery, and any business where visitor privacy is non-negotiable.

Free Plan (no credit card required)

Every Mika account starts with a free plan that includes:

  • ~30 conversations per month
  • Lead capture with instant email notifications
  • 8-language support with automatic detection
  • Custom welcome message
  • Works on any website

Paid Plans

  • Core ($9.99/mo) – ~94 conversations/mo, appointment booking, custom guardrails, exit intent triggers
  • Plus ($19.99/mo) – ~250 conversations/mo, follow-up emails, custom branding, proactive triggers, returning visitor greetings
  • Pro ($49.99/mo) – Unlimited conversations, full widget customization, zero-storage privacy mode, SMS lead alerts, dedicated account team

14-day free trial available on all paid plans. No commitment.

How It Works

  1. Sign up at hiremika.com (free, no credit card)
  2. Mika scans your website and learns your business: services, hours, location, and more
  3. Review and customize your welcome message, personality, and goals
  4. Install this plugin, paste your API key, and enable the widget
  5. Start capturing leads. Mika answers visitor questions and sends you warm leads via email

Industries That Use Mika

Mika works for any small business with a website. Popular industries include:

  • Dental offices and medical practices (with zero-storage privacy mode)
  • Therapy and counseling practices (with zero-storage privacy mode)
  • Law firms and legal practices (with zero-storage privacy mode)
  • Accounting and financial advisory firms
  • HVAC, plumbing, and home services
  • Real estate agencies
  • Salons and spas
  • Car dealerships (with live inventory search and photo cards)
  • Retail stores and boutiques (with product catalog search)
  • Restaurants and hospitality
  • Course creators and membership sites
  • And 20+ more industry-specific configurations

What This Plugin Does

This plugin adds the Mika AI chat widget to your WordPress site by inserting a small JavaScript snippet in your site’s footer. The snippet loads the Mika widget from api.hiremika.com, which displays a floating chat button on your pages.

When visitors click the chat button, they can have a conversation with Mika, your AI assistant. Mika uses the information from your website to answer questions, capture contact details, and book appointments.

External service: This plugin connects to hiremika.com, a third-party AI chat service operated by Dcipher LLC. Visitor chat messages are sent to Mika’s servers for AI processing. No WordPress admin data, user accounts, or site configuration is transmitted. Review our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Plugin Features

  • One-click installation from the WordPress plugin directory
  • Settings page under Settings > Mika AI Chat
  • Test Connection button to verify your API key works
  • Enable/disable toggle to control when the widget appears
  • Widget position selector (bottom-right or bottom-left)
  • Page exclusion to hide the widget on specific pages or posts
  • Per-page disable checkbox in the post/page editor sidebar
  • Clean uninstall removes all plugin data when deleted
  • Lightweight with zero impact on page load speed (script loads asynchronously)
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the mika-ai-chat folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Mika AI Chat
  4. If you do not have a Mika account, sign up for free
  5. Paste your API key (found in your Mika dashboard under Overview)
  6. Click Test Connection to verify your key
  7. Check Enable Widget and click Save Changes
  8. Visit your site to see the Mika chat button in the bottom-right corner
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Sign up for a free account at hiremika.com/signup. After Mika scans your website, you will find your API key on the dashboard Overview page. It starts with pk_.

Is Mika really free?

Yes. The free plan includes ~30 conversations per month, lead capture, and 8-language support. No credit card required. Paid plans start at $9.99/month with a 14-day free trial.

What data is sent to hiremika.com?

Only visitor chat messages typed into the widget are sent to Mika’s servers for AI processing. No WordPress admin data, user credentials, database content, or site configuration is transmitted. See our Privacy Policy.

Is Mika safe for privacy-sensitive industries?

Mika offers a zero-storage privacy mode for businesses that handle sensitive visitor information. When enabled, visitor data (names, phone numbers, emails, insurance IDs) is redacted before AI processing and never stored in any database. Lead details are delivered through encrypted, PIN-protected links. This is designed for healthcare practices, therapists, legal offices, financial advisors, and similar industries where visitor privacy is critical. Available on the Pro plan.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Mika appears on all WooCommerce pages including product, cart, and checkout. On retail plans, visitors can search your product catalog directly in chat and see product cards with photos, prices, and links.

Does it work with MemberPress or LearnDash?

Yes. Mika runs on any WordPress page, including membership gates, course pages, and checkout flows. It helps convert visitors who are browsing your offerings but have not signed up yet.

Does it work with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Yes. Mika loads as a floating widget overlay and does not interfere with any page builder. It works with Elementor, Divi, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress, Beaver Builder, and all other WordPress themes and page builders.

Can I hide the widget on specific pages?

Yes, two ways: (1) Enter comma-separated page IDs in the Exclude Pages field on the settings page, or (2) check the “Disable Mika Chat” box in the sidebar when editing any page or post.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The Mika script loads asynchronously and does not block page rendering. The initial script is under 10KB. All heavy resources load only when a visitor opens the chat.

Can I customize the widget colors and appearance?

Yes, but customization is managed from your Mika dashboard, not from WordPress. Brand colors are available on the Plus plan. Full widget customization is available on the Pro plan.

Does Mika support multiple languages?

Yes. Mika automatically detects the visitor’s language and responds in kind. Supported languages: English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Chinese, and Korean.

Can multiple team members access the dashboard?

Yes. Invite team members with role-based access: owners manage billing and account settings, admins manage content and configuration, and staff can view conversations and manage their own appointments.

What happens if I reach my message limit?

The widget shows a friendly message with your business contact information (phone, email) so visitors can still reach you. No conversations are cut off mid-chat.

I have a Content Security Policy (CSP) that blocks external scripts. What do I do?

Add api.hiremika.com to your CSP script-src and frame-src directives. If you use a WordPress security plugin like Wordfence or iThemes Security, add api.hiremika.com to the allowed domains list.
